metadata.description: LADC 2026 revision campaign: sound derived-preimage contracts, verified-bound tightening, block-width, relational-cut, and invariant ablations

campaign_arms.A: Block-width sweep beta in {0, 1, 2, 5, 10}; beta=0 is the monolithic baseline.
campaign_arms.B: Relational-cut ablation at beta=2. The cuts-on control is Arm A beta=2; this arm contributes only cuts-off runs.
campaign_arms.C: Invariant-injection ablation at beta=2. The invariants-on control is Arm A beta=2; this arm contributes only invariants-off runs.
campaign_arms.D: Timeout-sensitivity templates. They are disabled because only beta=2 regions unresolved in Arm A should be rerun at larger budgets.

cohort_definition.mnist_1blk_10: Sample 3 at raw-pixel epsilon {0.25, 0.5, 1.0, 2.0, 4.0}; nested-radius frontier.
cohort_definition.mnist_2blk_10_10: Sample 3 at the same epsilon frontier; depth-effect cohort.
cohort_definition.mnist_1blk_25: Fixed correctly classified samples 3, 2228, and 9389 at raw-pixel epsilon 0.25; width-effect cohort matching the established MNIST anchors.
cohort_definition.iris: Samples 0..9 from the deterministic repository test split at epsilon 0.01.

notes: All enabled runs use the sound derived error budget, strict zero contract tolerance, enforced contract chaining, MILP preimages, and no E2E fallback.
tighten_verified_bounds is enabled throughout. It is a sound, ESBMC-validated reachable-bound tightening step and must be reported as part of this revision's methodology.
A positive block width decomposes hidden-layer ESBMC obligations only. Every block in a layer uses the same shared Q/I/F; the output layer is not block-decomposed.
blockwise_run_all_blocks_on_failure is enabled so block-width measurements retain a complete block-query denominator. This is a diagnostics choice, not a mixed-precision policy.
formal no-saturation is required in this campaign. Therefore, only final_status=VERIFIED with guarantee_level=deployed-transfer is a certified region.
MNIST radii are raw pixel values and are normalized internally by 255. Iris and Seeds radii use their preprocessed input domains.
TIMEOUT, MEMOUT, UNKNOWN, SOURCE_PROPERTY_INCONCLUSIVE, and layer/preimage inconclusive outcomes are measured results. Do not replace their input regions or remove them from the per-region appendix.

The timeout-sensitivity arm is intentionally disabled. After Arm A, copy or enable only the beta=2 regions that were unresolved; otherwise it would waste the 1800-second budget on already settled regions.

runs.notes: Template only. Clone individual unresolved Arm-A beta=2 regions, set one timeout budget per clone, and enable those clones. The current runner cannot select unresolved results dynamically.
